[AstroNomad Studios](https://hitmarker.net/companies/astronomad-studios) [A![](https://hitmarker.net/imager/company/logo/4924535/1790272619_14cd2528e1.webp)](https://hitmarker.net/companies/astronomad-studios) [AstroNomad Studios](https://hitmarker.net/companies/astronomad-studios)·[ 1 open role ](https://hitmarker.net/companies/astronomad-studios) # Senior Systems Game Designer Location ![🌎](https://hitmarker.net/assets/twemoji/1f30e.svg)Remote (North America) Level Senior (5+ years) Contract Full Time Posted 1 day ago Still accepting applications [Sign in to apply](https://hitmarker.net/login) Save Copy linkShare * Apply in seconds with a Hitmarker profile * Get discovered by studios hiring now * Track every application in one place Report listing [A![](https://hitmarker.net/imager/company/logo/4924535/1790272619_14cd2528e1.webp)](https://hitmarker.net/companies/astronomad-studios) [AstroNomad Studios](https://hitmarker.net/companies/astronomad-studios) Founded by AAA veterans, AstroNomad is a remote-first game studio built on pure craft, bold ideas, and player-focused worlds. [astronomad.com](https://astronomad.com/) [ ![Game Design Skills](https://hitmarker.net/assets/game-design-skills-logo.webp)Learn game design from industry experts and build your portfolio to land roles faster Game Design Skills Bootcamps Autumn 2026 · Enrol by 29 September ](https://htmr.kr/gds) **AstroNomad Studios** is a new, small, distributed game studio backed by AIC. We are building original, expressive games with strong mechanical identity, memorable worlds, and a focus on player discovery, mastery, and adventure. We are looking for a **Senior Systems Game Designer** to help architect, prototype, tune, and connect the gameplay systems at the heart of our current project, with a particular focus on roguelike/roguelite structure, build variety, progression, and replayability. This is a hands-on senior design role for someone who can think deeply about mechanics, model and tune complex systems, communicate clearly with a small team, and turn abstract gameplay goals into practical, testable, shippable systems. ## What You’ll Do * Architect, model, and balance interconnected gameplay systems, including combat rules, traversal, abilities, upgrades, encounters, resources, progression, reward economies, and run structure. * Design systems that support roguelike/roguelite replayability, including buildcraft, synergies, risk/reward choices, intra-run progression, meta-progression, procedural variation, and difficulty escalation. * Translate creative direction into clear systemic rules, player verbs, constraints, feedback loops, tuning targets, data structures, and implementation-ready specs. * Work closely with leadership, engineering, level design, animation, art, and production to make sure systems are fun, readable, extensible, and buildable. * Create precise, practical design documentation, tuning tables, state-machine breakdowns, economy models, and balance notes that help the team make decisions and implement features. * Prototype, test, tune, and refine mechanics based on feel, readability, pacing, replayability, systemic depth, and production realities. * Partner with engineers and technical designers to implement and iterate systems in-engine, with Unreal Engine experience especially valuable. * Identify design risks early and help propose focused, achievable solutions that preserve depth without creating unnecessary complexity. * Support the creation of a game that rewards curiosity, mastery, movement, exploration, experimentation, and player discovery. ## What We’re Looking For * Demonstrated experience designing gameplay systems for roguelike/roguelite, run-based, action, combat, traversal, or similarly mechanics-driven games. * Strong systems-design instincts: you understand how rules, numbers, probabilities, player verbs, feedback loops, and constraints interact to create emergent play. * Experience designing or tuning build variety, upgrade synergies, reward structures, difficulty curves, progression systems, economies, or combat/ability systems. * Ability to break down complex gameplay ideas into simple, testable components, then tune them through iteration, data, player feel, and team feedback. * Comfort working with formulas, spreadsheets, tuning tables, probability, scaling math, or lightweight simulations to support design decisions. * Hands-on experience prototyping or implementing systems in a modern game engine. Unreal Engine experience, including Blueprint and/or C++, is especially relevant, though strong experience in Unity, Godot, proprietary engines, or similar tools is also welcome. * Clear written and verbal communication, including the ability to create documentation that engineers, artists, animators, designers, and producers can actually use. * Comfort working in a small team where roles may overlap, priorities change, and ownership matters. * Good taste in systemic design — not just adding mechanics, but knowing what should be removed, simplified, clarified, or tuned. * A practical mindset: you care about what can actually be built, tested, balanced, and improved. ## Preferred Experience * Shipped-title experience or equivalent production experience taking gameplay systems from prototype through implementation, tuning, polish, and release. * Deep experience with roguelike/roguelite systems, run architecture, buildcraft, procedural variation, reward economies, meta-progression, or long-term replayability. * Strong Unreal Engine experience, especially designing, prototyping, scripting, or tuning gameplay systems in Blueprint, C++, data assets, gameplay tags, or related Unreal workflows. * Experience with data-driven ability systems, enemy interactions, combat rulesets, progression systems, or environmental gameplay. * Background in action-adventure games, traversal-heavy games, combat systems, platforming, or exploration-focused design. * Experience collaborating with engineering on systemic architecture, tools, data schemas, content pipelines, or balancing workflows. * Comfort working remotely with a distributed team. * Interest in stylized, expressive, mythic, fairy-tale-inspired, or strange worlds. ## About AstroNomad Studios AstroNomad Studios is the game-development arm of AIC. We are a new studio building a small, focused, distributed team around original games with strong mechanical identity and expressive worlds. We are drawn to games that combine movement, danger, discovery, mastery, replayability, and atmosphere — games where systems are not just features, but part of how the player understands and inhabits the world. We are early, ambitious, and practical. That means we care about distinctive creative direction, but also about scope, clarity, ownership, and making decisions a small team can actually execute. If you like building systems that support adventure, replayability, player expression, and meaningful choices — not just isolated mechanics — this may be a strong fit. ## How to Apply Please apply with: * Your resume or portfolio. * Examples of gameplay systems, mechanics, prototypes, tools, tuning models, or shipped work you directly contributed to. * If available, design documentation, economy models, balance sheets, state-machine breakdowns, synergy matrices, or other examples of how you think through systems. * A short note about one roguelike, roguelite, action, or systems-driven game system you admire and why it works. We value proven design instincts, clear communication, practical execution, and the autonomy to help drive complex systems in a small team. We do not need every candidate to match every bullet exactly, but we are especially interested in designers with senior-level systems ownership, roguelike/roguelite fluency, and hands-on engine experience. * [Game Design](https://hitmarker.net/jobs?tag=122732) * [Systems Design](https://hitmarker.net/jobs?tag=122691) * [Unreal Engine](https://hitmarker.net/jobs?tag=122699) [A![](https://hitmarker.net/imager/company/logo/4924535/1790272619_14cd2528e1.webp)](https://hitmarker.net/companies/astronomad-studios) [AstroNomad Studios](https://hitmarker.net/companies/astronomad-studios)· Senior Systems Game Designer [![Hitmarker](https://hitmarker.net/assets/hitmarker.svg)](https://hitmarker.net/) Find jobs across games, esports, content and media. Headquarters Stockholm, Sweden Headcount 11-50 people Workplace Remote Founded 2025 [scapethegame.com](https://scapethegame.com/) [ScapeWorld Entertainment AB on LinkedIn](https://linkedin.com/company/scapethegame)[ScapeWorld Entertainment AB on X](https://x.com/ScapeTheGame) ## More roles [Senior Producer![🌎](https://hitmarker.net/assets/twemoji/1f30e.svg)Remote (Anywhere)18 days ago](https://hitmarker.net/jobs/scapeworld-entertainment-ab-senior-producer-4717361) [ ![Game Design Skills](https://hitmarker.net/assets/game-design-skills-logo.webp)Learn game design from industry experts and build your portfolio to land roles faster Game Design Skills Bootcamps Autumn 2026 · Enrol by 29 September ](https://htmr.kr/gds) **Senior Community Manager, APAC · Scape** ScapeWorld Entertainment · Remote **Location:** Asia Pacific outside mainland China ### About us We are Scape, a Swedish game studio of about 30 people, fully remote by choice. We are launching Gravity on Steam Early Access later this year: a precision climbing game where 100 players share one server, one tower, and one long way down. Gravity is the first game inside Scape, a growing platform of multiplayer games where a player's identity carries across all of them; Scape itself follows. Our senior team has shipped and run live games at studios including Arrowhead (Helldivers 2), Avalanche Studios, and Ubisoft. Gravity is designed to be clipped, streamed and shared, and a large part of that happens in Asia Pacific. We are looking for the person who builds our community there from its first thousand members. ### The role Community is our growth engine, not our support desk. We are hiring the person who builds and runs our community in Asia Pacific, with Greater China as the priority market and Japan and Korea as the next two. Chinese-speaking players are one of the largest audiences on Steam, and we want to meet them in their own language and on their own platforms from day one. You are our first person in the region. You report to our Lead Community Manager, who owns our player community worldwide and sets the frame you work inside, and you work daily with our Lead Commercial Manager, who owns our creator and clipper relationships. Inside that frame, the Chinese-language community is yours to build and run. ### What you will own * Our community in Greater China: its channels, its daily presence, how our voice sounds in Chinese, and its growth from the first thousand members. * Our Chinese channels, including official presence on Bilibili, Xiaohongshu and other platforms as we open them, and the operational work of getting a foreign studio verified and compliant on each. * The Chinese-language surface on Steam: discussions, replies and reviews in Chinese, and the in-territory read of our translated store text and announcements. * Japan and Korea through a volunteer moderator program: recruiting, briefing and running moderators who cover languages you do not read, with clear rules and a clear escalation path that you help write. * Day-to-day communication with the clipper and creator network across the region, alongside our Lead Commercial Manager, who owns the relationships. * Creator events and play sessions in the region's prime time that fill 100-player servers. * Planning and hosting live sessions in Chinese and English: AMAs, developer Q&As, play nights. * Daily monitoring for problems that grow fast, and the judgement to know what to escalate and what to leave alone. ### You * Fluent in spoken Mandarin and write Simplified Chinese. * Know the Chinese platform landscape from the inside: Bilibili, Xiaohongshu, Douyin, Heybox, WeChat, QQ, and the Chinese-language player community on Steam. Understand how those platforms work for a foreign company: account onboarding and enterprise verification, real-name requirements, content-review regimes. * Have run community for a live multiplayer game through a launch or a period of real growth, and can say what broke. * Based in Asia Pacific outside mainland China. * Fluent in English, our working language, and write fast and well in both languages. The application questions are answered in English. * Understand creator culture firsthand, including how agencies and MCNs sit between a studio and a creator. * Comfortable on camera and hosting live in Chinese and English. * Have run moderators or a volunteer team, ideally across a language you did not speak. * Stay calm when something blows up at 23:00 on a weekend. * Work the region's prime time, with a fixed daily overlap window with our team in Central Europe. Evenings around events are part of the work. ### Helpful, not required * You write Traditional Chinese as well. * You read Japanese or Korean. * You sit close to China's time zone. ### What we offer A market to build from its first thousand members, with a game designed to produce moments people share, a creator program, and a marketing framework already in place. We are a self-motivated team, remote by choice and flexible in how we work, and we run on people helping each other rather than watching each other. No timesheets, no theatre: everyone here is trusted to own their part, and supported when they need a hand. And we are early. Gravity is heading to Steam with everything still ahead of it. Joining now means building something with a real chance of becoming big, and being one of the people it belongs to when it does. ### Practical * Remote. You are based in Asia Pacific outside mainland China, and your working day is the region's prime time. * Full time, on a long-term contract. * Recruitment is ongoing. ### Disclosure This application will be evaluated with the help of an AI tool that checks your CV and application against the criteria for this role. A human recruiter always makes the final decision. The AI does not reject or accept anyone on its own. If your application isn't taken forward, you can ask us for an explanation of how the AI was used in that decision. See our Candidate Privacy Policy below for full details, or contact us at privacy@br.ink with any questions. * [Community Management](https://hitmarker.net/jobs?tag=122775) * [Events](https://hitmarker.net/jobs?tag=122759) * [Social Media](https://hitmarker.net/jobs?tag=122712) [S![](https://hitmarker.net/imager/company/logo/4717497/1788771168_14cd2528e1.webp)](https://hitmarker.net/companies/scapeworld-entertainment-ab) [ScapeWorld Entertainment AB](https://hitmarker.net/companies/scapeworld-entertainment-ab)· Senior Community Manager, APAC [![Hitmarker](https://hitmarker.net/assets/hitmarker.svg)](https://hitmarker.net/) Find jobs across games, esports, content and media. Headquarters Dubai, DU, United Arab Emirates Headcount 11-50 people Workplace Hybrid Founded 2021 [strayshot.game](https://www.strayshot.game) [iBLOXX Studios DMCC on LinkedIn](https://linkedin.com/ibloxxstudios)[iBLOXX Studios DMCC on X](https://x.com/StrayShotGame) [ ![Game Design Skills](https://hitmarker.net/assets/game-design-skills-logo.webp)Learn game design from industry experts and build your portfolio to land roles faster Game Design Skills Bootcamps Autumn 2026 · Enrol by 29 September ](https://htmr.kr/gds) ### Realistic Shooter / Unreal Engine We are looking for a talented and hands-on **Game UI & Multimedia Designer** to join our team working on a mobile-first realistic shooter built in Unreal Engine 5. The main focus of this role is creating **high-quality, visually impressive UI for a modern realistic shooter**. You will design everything from HUDs and gameplay interfaces to menus, inventories, loadouts, matchmaking, mission screens and progression systems. You will work closely with our game designers and Unreal developers, who will bring your designs into the game. You should therefore have a good understanding of **Unreal Engine 5 and UMG** , but this is primarily a **visual design role** — we are looking for someone whose strongest skill is creating exceptional game UI, rather than programming or technical implementation. Alongside game UI, you will also create **gameplay clips, trailers, motion graphics and promotional content** using footage captured from the game. ### **What we are looking for** * Strong professional experience in **game UI design** , ideally for shooters, action games or realistic games * A strong portfolio showing **polished, modern HUDs and in-game UI** * Excellent understanding of the visual language used in **realistic and military-style games** * Ability to design complete game interfaces, including HUDs, menus, inventories, loadouts, mission screens, progression systems and other gameplay UI * Strong UI/UX fundamentals, combining visual quality with readability and gameplay usability * Good understanding of **Unreal Engine 5 and UMG** , with the ability to prepare designs and assets for efficient implementation by our Unreal team * Strong knowledge of **Photoshop, Illustrator, Figma, After Effects, Premiere** or equivalent tools * Ability to create **animated UI, motion graphics and UI transitions** * Ability to capture and edit compelling **gameplay footage, gameplay clips and trailers** * Good understanding of cinematic editing, pacing, sound and presentation for game marketing content * Comfortable using **AI tools** for ideation, design exploration and content creation * Strong visual eye and exceptional attention to detail * Highly organized and systematic when managing source files, assets, versions and deliverables ### **Most important** We are looking for someone who can take a gameplay requirement, concept or rough wireframe and transform it into a **visually outstanding, production-ready game UI**. Your portfolio should show UI that could belong in a **high-quality modern shooter**. We are not primarily looking for candidates whose experience is focused on websites, mobile apps or corporate interfaces. **Location:** B2B offshore/remote. If this sounds like you, we would love to see your **portfolio and CV** , together with your salary expectations. Please send them to **hr@ibloxx.com**. * [Motion Design](https://hitmarker.net/jobs?tag=122720) * [UI Design](https://hitmarker.net/jobs?tag=122697) * [UX Design](https://hitmarker.net/jobs?tag=122701) * [Video Editing](https://hitmarker.net/jobs?tag=3434760) [i![](https://hitmarker.net/imager/company/logo/1291746/1750433302_14cd2528e1.webp)](https://hitmarker.net/companies/ibloxx-studios-dmcc) [iBLOXX Studios DMCC](https://hitmarker.net/companies/ibloxx-studios-dmcc)· Senior Game UI & Multimedia Designer [![Hitmarker](https://hitmarker.net/assets/hitmarker.svg)](https://hitmarker.net/) Find jobs across games, esports, content and media. Join our team and help write our success story! [wooga.com](https://www.wooga.com/) [Wooga on LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/company/wooga/)[Wooga on X](https://twitter.com/wooga) ## More roles [Senior User Acquisition Manager![🇩🇪](https://hitmarker.net/assets/twemoji/1f1e9-1f1ea.svg)Berlin, Germany2 days ago](https://hitmarker.net/jobs/wooga-senior-user-acquisition-manager-4918306) [ ![Game Design Skills](https://hitmarker.net/assets/game-design-skills-logo.webp)Learn game design from industry experts and build your portfolio to land roles faster Game Design Skills Bootcamps Autumn 2026 · Enrol by 29 September ](https://htmr.kr/gds) ## Our Story Founded in 2009, we’re one of the world’s leading game studios, and proud of our extremely international team, consisting of more than 50 different nations. We are part of Playtika and the global leader in the category of Hidden Object Games. With June’s Journey, we’re providing joy for millions of players around the world every day. ## How we work Our aim is to keep doing so for many more years, if not decades. In order to be able to do so, we’ve defined a distinct way of how we’re working at Wooga, so that all relevant aspects intertwine and have a positive impact on the game. No matter if you’re part of a game team or support the success of Wooga as part of a central team, all 250+ employees from around the world can make an impact. We’re proud of the environment we’ve built, and believe you’ll enjoy working with some of the best people in the industry. Our drivers: Speed, Focus, Ownership, and Impact, guide our working style at Wooga and help us make a deliberate choice to focus on what is important to us, while working towards a shared goal. These drivers shape how we work together and what we expect from ourselves and our leaders. As a Marketing Data Analyst, you will analyze large-scale data across user acquisition touchpoints in order to generate insightful metrics, custom dashboards, and deep-dive analyses to measure marketing performance. Our marketing teams aim for best-in-class user acquisition strategies, bringing high-quality players to our games while driving innovation around performance marketing and targeted campaigns. We're looking for a passionate, results-oriented talent to join our team, develop new insights to shape data-driven decisions, continuously improve marketing efficiency, and help drive business growth for years to come. ## About the job * Design, build, and maintain automated, interactive dashboards in Tableau to give the Marketing team up-to-date visibility into performance and KPIs. * Dive deep into large-scale marketing data to identify key insights that will inform user acquisition strategies and business growth. * Help define how best to measure and monitor our marketing channels, creatives, budget allocation, and overall campaign performance. * Help to develop an analysis strategy and perform analysis of complex campaigns and A/B tests, both systematically and on a one-off basis. * Provide data-driven recommendations to help Marketing Managers optimize their campaigns across various channels (e.g., Facebook Audience Network, Snapchat, TikTok). * Partner with Data Engineering on data gathering and signal sharing, integrating 3rd-party data providers (e.g., AppsFlyer, Kochava), democratizing data with reporting tools, AI Agents, and innovating workflows. * Communicate actionable results and data-driven findings across the organization clearly and concisely. ## About you * You have recent experience in a data analyst role, preferably in digital advertising, performance marketing, or the app industry. * You have experience with (app) Attribution Services (eg: AppsFlyer or Kochava). * Literacy on Agentic Workflows, and other productivity and modern self-service data innovations. * You can use SQL effectively within an enterprise data environment and you have a good understanding of commonly applied statistical techniques. Basic understanding of programming is not required, but is appreciated. * You have strong experience using Tableau (or similar) to build interactive dashboards and visualizations. * You have good problem-solving skills and can look for logical connections between marketing spend, consumer behavior, and data. * You have a deep understanding of the digital advertising market,including communication patterns as they relate to consumer marketing. You are in tune with user acquisition patterns, and you understand mobile app growth. * You know your way around designing, communicating, visualizing, or reporting your results/analysis so they are clear and unambiguous to both technical and non-technical audiences. **Please note: Research has shown that some under-represented groups in the gaming industry (eg: women) tend to apply only if they meet every single requirement. Here at Wooga, the desire to learn and the willingness to solve problems are more important to us than your experience on paper. We encourage you to apply even if you do not think that you tick all the boxes - thinking outside of such boxes and embracing the diversity of mindsets and backgrounds is what we believe makes our teams thrive.** ## Our Promise * Shape the future! Challenge the status quo and team up with a diverse group of experts (over 50 nationalities!) working on crafting the world’s best games. * We offer a generous relocation package and home search support if you are not already located in Berlin. Did we mention that we also cooperate with Kindergartens? * Make use of a significant education budget and extra days off for self-development. Join our meet-ups, talks, brown bag lunches, internal trainings, workshops and many others. * Enjoy the yoga, mindfulness app, sports and transport subsidies. And a Purpose Day to donate your time to a worthy cause! * Did you know that German is the third most commonly taught language worldwide? Learn it too! We offer German language classes for you and your significant other. * With our hybrid work model you will work in the office with your teams twice a week, to encourage in-person collaboration and team bonding The other three days you can choose if you want to work from home or from the office. We also offer 10 days a year to work from abroad. _At Wooga we are committed to providing a friendly, safe and welcoming environment for everyone who works here or with us, regardless of gender, gender identity and expression, sexual orientation, disability, physical appearance, body size, race, age, religion (or lack thereof) and game preferences. Be yourself, we like you that way!_ By clicking “Submit Application” you acknowledge that you have read our [Candidate Privacy Policy](https://www.wooga.com/legal/en-candidates-privacy-policy) * [Marketing](https://hitmarker.net/jobs?tag=122747) * [Data Analysis](https://hitmarker.net/jobs?tag=122750) [W![](https://hitmarker.net/imager/company/logo/1297450/1750439373_14cd2528e1.webp)](https://hitmarker.net/companies/wooga) [Wooga](https://hitmarker.net/companies/wooga)· Marketing Data Analyst (18-month contract) [![Hitmarker](https://hitmarker.net/assets/hitmarker.svg)](https://hitmarker.net/) Find jobs across games, esports, content and media. NVIDIA is seeking passionate engineers to build the next generation of tools used by AI developers and researchers worldwide. Our team is developing [Thunder](https://github.com/Lightning-AI/lightning-thunder), an ambitious, source-to-source compiler built to unlock outstanding performance for PyTorch models on NVIDIA GPUs. This is a unique opportunity to contribute to a project that enhances the PyTorch ecosystem, working with modern compiler stacks like PyTorch 2.0's TorchDynamo and TorchInductor to create powerful, open-source solutions that benefit the entire community. If you are driven to solve complex problems and want to make a foundational impact on the AI ecosystem, apply to join our collaborative and innovative team. ### What you'll be doing As a key member of our team, you will be contributing directly to the future of accelerated AI. Your role will be dynamic and deeply technical, placing you at the center of compiler innovation. You will lead the design, implementation, optimization, and maintenance of the core compiler technologies that accelerate massive deep learning workloads. This is a highly collaborative role where you'll work alongside the very engineers who built PyTorch for NVIDIA hardware, helping to pioneer new features and stay at the forefront of framework development. You'll dive deep into performance analysis, scrutinizing workloads running on thousands of GPUs to find optimization opportunities that will shape the future design of Thunder. Furthermore, you will be part of a vibrant ecosystem, working closely with leading compiler, library, and systems teams—including experts behind nvFuser, TVM, XLA, and CUDA—to translate the latest research into practical, high-impact solutions for the open-source community. ### What we need to see We are looking for engineers who are excited about building powerful, user-centric tools and are comfortable working in a fast-paced, collaborative environment. Here are some of the expertise we would like to see: * A Bachelor's, Master's, or Ph.D. in Computer Science or a related technical field (or equivalent experience). * 8+ years of relevant work experience * A strong command of Python and experience building complex, well-tested software systems. * Hands-on experience with deep learning frameworks like PyTorch or JAX. You understand how models are built and where the performance challenges lie. * A solid foundation in compiler concepts such as abstract syntax trees (ASTs), intermediate representations (e.g., SSA form), program analysis, and code generation. * Excellent communication and collaboration skills, essential for working effectively in a distributed, open-source environment. ### Ways to stand out from the crowd * Previous contributions to deep learning compiler projects (e.g., TVM, MLIR, IREE) or deep learning frameworks themselves. * Deep expertise in the internals of PyTorch, particularly its compiler stack (TorchDynamo, TorchInductor). * Experience with JAX-like functional transformations and their application in a compiler context. * Familiarity with parallel programming, distributed systems, and writing high-performance CUDA code. * A track record of impactful participation in open-source communities, such as through code contributions, design discussions, or mentorship. NVIDIA is at the forefront of breakthroughs in Artificial Intelligence, High-Performance Computing, and Visualization. Our teams are composed of driven, innovative professionals dedicated to pushing the boundaries of technology. We offer highly competitive salaries, an extensive benefits package, and a work environment that promotes diversity, inclusion, and flexibility. As an equal opportunity employer, we are committed to fostering a supportive and empowering workplace for all. Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and the pay of employees in similar positions.
